component.name: LongHorizon-Harness
component.summary: Role-orchestrated harness for long-horizon computer-use tasks

description.p: LongHorizon-Harness coordinates Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or DeepSeek Harness through Manager, Executor, and Auditor roles to keep an agent working reliably across desktop and terminal tasks that span many hours. It plans, acts, verifies results independently, and checkpoints or recovers as needed rather than losing progress when a single agent invocation runs out of context or drifts off task.
Tasks can blend GUI workflows, such as clicking, scrolling, and document editing, with CLI operations like code modification, command execution, and system configuration.

This package ships the lh-harness CLI only; the optional browser-based Web UI is not bundled, since building it requires a Node.js toolchain. The CLI, including lh-harness run, lh-harness init, and lh-harness doctor, is fully functional without it.
Requires one of the following agent backends to be available in PATH at runtime: claude, codex, opencode, or dsh.
